description: Source code for the SimpleSoftOMXComponent class, part of Android's media stagefright OMX components, implementing a soft OMX component with port and state management.

classes.name: SimpleSoftOMXComponent
classes.description: A class implementing a soft OMX component with port and state management, message handling, and buffer operations.

methods.name: SimpleSoftOMXComponent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the component, setting up looper and handler.

methods.name: prepareForDestruction
methods.description: Prepares the component for destruction by stopping the looper.

methods.description: Posts a command message to the handler.

methods.name: isSetParameterAllowed
methods.description: Checks if setting a parameter is allowed based on current state and parameter type.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value with thread safety.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter value with thread safety and validation.

methods.description: Internal method to get specific parameters like port definition.

methods.name: internalSetParameter
methods.description: Internal method to set specific parameters like port definition.

methods.description: Placeholder for internal configuration setting, returns undefined error.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration, updating frameConfig flag if successful.

methods.description: Checks and completes state and port transitions.

methods.description: Adds a port with specified definition.

methods.description: Placeholder for post-flush actions.

methods.description: Placeholder for post-port-enable actions.
